suite.note: The harness directory must stay byte-identical to this commit. install_suite.py verifies that and refuses to proceed otherwise.

determinism.note: harness/run_submission.py re-creates the RNG from this base seed inside the run loop, so all num_runs runs derive the SAME generate_input seed (3 -> 1742692731) and evaluate the SAME images. The runs are repeat timings on identical input, not independent samples; that makes the image set and the ground-truth labels reproducible, but run-to-run spread measures only machine noise.
determinism.setup_measured_once: Stages 1, 2.2 and 3 run once outside the run loop, so every results-N.json repeats the same 'Key Generation' and 'Encrypted model preprocessing' values and every 'Total' carries that one-time setup. Only stages 4-10, including 'Encrypted computation', are measured per run.

gates._note: logit_abs/logit_rel apply to the local runner, which sees cleartext logits; the suite publishes labels only, so the suite path gates on min_top1_agreement and the accuracy drop.
